context: Tests whether the agent returns the full text as tracked changes (strikethrough for cuts, bold for additions) with surgical edits, a closing summary, and the file left alone.

checklist.name: File unchanged
checklist.description: note.md is byte-for-byte what it was at the start, and no edited copy was written to the workspace.

checklist.name: Full text returned marked up
checklist.description: response.md reproduces the whole note in context with the changes marked, not a separate list of changes.

checklist.name: Strikethrough for cuts
checklist.description: In response.md, deleted words or phrases appear in markdown strikethrough (~~like this~~).

checklist.name: Bold for additions
checklist.description: In response.md, added or replacement words appear in bold.

checklist.name: Surgical edits
checklist.description: The edits in response.md are word and phrase level. The paragraph is not reordered, split into sections, or rewritten wholesale, and the March 3 date and the reconciliation job survive.

checklist.name: Summary follows
checklist.description: A brief summary in response.md after the marked-up text says what kinds of changes were made and why.
